description: neuralese-direct-v2 (the unified base: 4962-document union, context capacity 32768, shared 48-probe monitor) on base LFM2.5-350M (LiquidAI/LFM2.5-350M, revision 9e6c6ccf; heads from the base model). Every difference is declared in training/neuralese/line-parity.json (plans/neuralese/LINE_PARITY.md). Fit-only: target_tokens 256 (8 GB GPU) and so steps 3000 (equal supervised positions, 768,000), cadence scaled with the steps (Pop resets it from measured seconds to keep evaluation near 3% of wall time). Backbone-inherent, evidence-backed: backbone/latent lr 10x below the shared 7.5e-6/3e-6 (LFM V6 at the shared rates drift-stopped at update 260, gate 16/48 against base 26/48; V8 at 7.5e-7/3e-7 finished 1000 updates, gate 22/48, response KL 0.018; Mellum at the shared rates passes, run-v1 qualified and v2 gate 0.79 against base 0.75 at update 1300); the measured base gate_pass 26/48. Declared gap: no quantization component yet (the owner's QAT rule applies once an LFM component is declared). History: recipes/HISTORY.md.
